Grants a midlevel haste effect, which boosts your movement speed while running, swimming, or climbing.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can drink Hasty Elixirs to receive a boost to his movement speed. This haste effect will influence his running, [[Swimming]], and [[Climbing]] speed. Hasty Elixirs come in three varying levels of potency, granting low-, mid-, and high-level improvements to his speed.{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Elixir}}
Grants a mid-level haste effect, which boosts your movement speed while running, swimming, or climbing.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Elixir}}
Grants a high-level haste effect, which boosts your movement speed while running, swimming, or climbing.|Inventory|BotW}} These [[Elixir]]s can be made by [[Cooking]] any of the following critters with [[Monster Part]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]: * [[Hightail Lizard]] * [[Hot-Footed Frog]] By adding any of these hasty ingredients, Link can make a Hasty Elixir that will also heal him: * [[Fleet-Lotus Seeds]] * [[Rushroom]] * [[Swift Violet]] * [[Swift Carrot]] ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Elixir }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Elixirs, Food, Health Restoring Items |items= BotW, TotK }}
